items.headline: [Materials] Albemarle Rises on Earnings as Global Lithium Demand Grows Faster Than Expected
items.snippet: ALB rising after Q2 earnings beat on EPS and sales. CEO cited improved pricing, specialty division performance, cost discipline. Global lithium demand up 45% YoY through May, outpacing supply.

items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Q2 2026 Earnings Call on Aug 6, 2026 - Transcript
items.snippet: Global lithium consumption up 45% YoY through May, tracking above forecast, driven by stationary storage strength. Supply increases coming slower than demand growth due to limited spodumene availability. Inventories low, physical market tight.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation - Albemarle Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: 2026 Outlook Considerations: sales volumes expected 225-235 kt LCE; scenarios assume flat market pricing flowing through Energy Storage's contract book (~40% of salts volume on long-term agreements).

items.headline: Here's How to Play Albemarle Stock Before Q2 Earnings Release
items.snippet: Falling lithium market prices are weighing on ALB stock amid slowing China EV demand, inventory glut and mine restarts. ALB shares down 16.1% YTD vs Zacks Chemical-Diversified +17.6% and S&P 500 +9.5%.

items.headline: Albemarle Stock Loses 25% in a Month: What Should Investors Do Now?
items.snippet: ALB shares tumbled 25.5% in the past month on falling lithium prices amid slowing China EV demand and inventory glut, though CATL and Mineral Resources restarting mines add supply pressure.
